manifest.demand: 4 TB/s per active compute; uniform within each logical object
manifest.resource_budget: 36C+36M; 1 TB/s and 16 GiB per memory; HB <=4 TB/s and controller 4 TB/s each
manifest.selection: Training throughput only among full-load-certified candidates within wire and width budgets; ties prefer smaller wire, width, beta, ID
manifest.scope: Functional fluid rates and physical proxies, not application speedup or PPA

verification.checks: Hashes, unique stripe/storage conservation, full-load certificate, all test floors/caps, oracle bounds, disjoint seeds and training-only winner recomputation
